resolution: Added the NARRATIVE SPINE to the void playbook — the thematic why that should set the tone for every seam. The protagonist is always 'looking to get away from this shitty place'; the world is built so escape always LOOKS in reach but both ends dead-end (the coast kills you for reaching across the water; the road folds you back two blocks from start). Geography as metaphor for the life that won't let you leave (ties to the opening arc req_0375 — broke/high/fired/trapped in the gig-crime CaaS loop), and PROTECT-THE-ZERO (V22) expressed as level design: no chosen one, no triumphant exit. Framed the void as the central metaphor the rest of the game is the setup for ('build the seams bleak'), not a bolted-on boundary. Added a new section to SKYBOX_PLAYBOOK.md and a matching 'The escape that dead-ends (narrative spine)' pattern to the _index record so the oracle surfaces it (verified — tops the 'looking to get away' query at 37.8). Committed 0fa2171b0.
